g_rules.text: Decide Job A (video carries hook) or Job B (caption is the content) and state which
Job A: caption is not a second hook; line 1 is the ask, plainly
Job A: body gives context that makes the ask make sense plus the search words
Job B (photo, single image, carousel cover): line 1 is the hook
Hook is concrete, short, cut off at a cliff rather than mid-clause
Line 1 fits in the 125 visible characters before the cut
Line 1 never a greeting, never a hashtag, never an emoji as first character
Body: short paragraphs with one line of white space between each
Body has two to six paragraphs
Exactly one ask (comment a keyword, save, or DM)
Hashtags: up to five, on their own line at the bottom, or none
Hashtags are specific topic labels; cut #viral #fyp #explorepage #foryou
Max 2,200 chars; keep it short (~600 chars beats 1,800)
Two or three search terms worked into caption text as natural phrases a human would type, not as hashtags
No link in the caption; send to bio or DM
Keyword ask uses one typeable word (no spaces, no emoji) and is said out loud in the video too
If there is a link, write the first comment separately and say so in the receipt
Emoji as punctuation not decoration; no more than 4 per 100 characters
Write alt text for carousels and photos
Receipt block 'CAPTION READY' with job, visible N of 125, ask, hashtags, search (phrase + line), linter fields
Print the copy-ready caption block first, then the receipt
Run /ig-human de-slop pass on the draft
Run caption.py with search terms; fix every FAIL, decide every WARN out loud
Hebrew: every line pure Hebrew or pure English; names/model names/URLs on own line
Hebrew: Hebrew hashtags on one line, English hashtags on the next
Hebrew: no em dashes
